title: Tapioca: modeled ₹351/qtl left, Kottakkal → Kattappana
summary: March 2022: reported tapioca prices at Kottakkal and Kattappana imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 95% of 20 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹351 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 12 same-variety market pairs screened for tapioca in March 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kattappana report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: March 2022
scenes.caption: Kottakkal (Kerala) and Kattappana (Kerala) both reported tapioca prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 20 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kottakkal reported a median ₹1,500 per quintal. Kattappana reported a median ₹2,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹550/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹550 per quintal, and Kattappana was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 246 km by road
scenes.caption: 246 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹53/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹291 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹167 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kattappana report, the rule selects 17 of 20 modeled shipping days. 16 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹351 per quintal (₹232 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Tapioca route from Kottakkal to Kattappana was positive on 95% of matched days in March 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹35,100, or ₹23,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to tapioca
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹53/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Tapioca route from Kottakkal to Kattappana was positive on 95% of matched days in March 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹35,100, or ₹23,200 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
